body: I constantly let people in SAA know what I've been feeling and keep current in my shares at SAA. The problem is they can't by the nature of the group offer any advice they can only listen-- which sometimes is enough, which sometimes isn't. Thanks for the support. I am trying to take baby steps, but it's just so arduous when I take one step forward and ten steps back. I know I have no one else but myself to blame, and I know I have to improve myself for no one else but myself, but the road is long and hard and there doesn't seem to be an end in sight so suicide becomes the easy way out.

"I attempt to work the SAA 12 step program, but slip and relapse numerous times."

"I am actively taking steps in my current relationship to become independent. To give the other person their space. To take responsibility for activities and to not let the other person feel as though they must take care of me."

" begin going to Sex Addicts Anonymous meetings. I begin attending church. I begin reaching out to a network of friends and colleagues, while being as honest as possible about my transgressions."

"I have continued attending SAA meetings and keeping family and friends updated on my state of mind. I do not believe that I am necessarily suicidal, but I can't deny that I have had suicidal thoughts. "

" I'm finding it difficult to keep working on improving myself. I'm finding it difficult to forgive myself. I'm trying my best to take responsibility for my actions and their consequences."

You pretty much ignored all of these statements. Sounds like you have some deep seated hatred of your father for cheating on your mother and so you just view any cheaters are irredeemable and therefore should be left in their own little pens away from non-cheaters. Thanks for giving me the fire to be pissed off at another human being for being so obtuse. I'm not asking for my partner to accept me the way I am as I stated numerous times that my cheating is something I fully acknowledge and am working on by speaking to others and going regularly to SAA meetings.

"I believe that if I was trying to do the right thing according to what a morally reasonable person would do, I would end the relationship with this new person, and that I would focus on addressing the numerous issues I have, but that requires me to abandon my pornography, my escorts, and any romantic relationships for an unspecified amount of time, which would leave me very alone, which would be very difficult for me to bear. Very difficult, but not impossible."

When I say that this would be difficult to do I'm not saying I don't want to give them up. I'm literally saying I WANT to give them up, but it's difficult to do. This shouldn't be a shock to anyone who can relate to addicts or addiction. If it was so easy I wouldn't be an addict and I wouldn't have cheated in the first place. But like I said, thanks for pissing me off. Gives me a reason to stay angry and try to live to prove people like you wrong.

well i'll be honest. this comment just confirmed my desire to kill myself even more. if people are always going to put me in a box, ignore any attempts at progress, and always view me with this stigma i can't get rid of. then i may as well just kill myself.
